race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
race.verdict: MASEGO was beaten 9 lengths by Clipsham Noble last time but still shaped well up with a strong pace on stable debut so could well reverse the form given his rival is a quirky sort prone to a bad start. Sahm Naif needs to prove his stamina but has a little more potential than most of these. MASEGO (IRE) CLIPSHAM NOBLE (IRE) SAHM NAIF (IRE)
